thread:
maria: quick idea0— expose a tiny pin hint for clients to surface which variant is sticky + advisory TTL?
kevin: cautious about leaking rollout labels. what minimal info do UIs need?
sophia: human name, rough ttl (secs), and pin type (hard/soft). no infra ids.
jon: opt-in only. header to request it so older clients ignore.
maria: propose request header `X-Redwood-Pin-View: true` -> server includes compact `pin_hint` in JSON response. default off.
kevin: require tenant opt-in in Console + per-request header to prove consent.
sophia: payload: compact, versioned, e.g. `v1|n:gpt-mini|t:3600|m:soft`, base64-url encoded to stay transport-safe.
jon: base64 keeps it opaque; clients can decode. include version field `v1` for future changes.
maria: TLV-like ascii is easy to parse; still encode it to avoid collisions.
kevin: security: unsigned blobs are display-only. support optional signed mode when tenant wants verifiable badges. tenant-managed signing key used to sign blob.
sophia: default unsigned (simpler). console toggle enables signed mode; server emits `pin_hint_sig` header for verification.
jon: redaction policy: if revealing private tags/overrides would leak infra, omit `pin_hint` entirely rather than returning a redacted token. simpler for clients.
maria: agreed. ops-only telemetry will include a reason code when omitted.
kevin: doc note: TTL is advisory; model may be rebound earlier. clients must not use pin_hint for security/auth decisions.
sophia: example response when enabled: `{"pin_hint":"djEgfG46Z3B0LW1pbml8dDozNjAwfG06c29mdA=="}` (decodes to `v1|n:gpt-mini|t:3600|m:soft`).
jon: follow-ups: 1) short RFC blurb for header + payload + signed mode + redaction policy, 2) Console UX copy for tenant toggle, 3) unit/integration tests for omission and signature verification, 4) SDK helpers for decode/verify.
maria: i'll draft the RFC and drop a link. thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: staging: feature-flag `compact-pin-view` toggled ON for org:acme-staging. :rocket:
